audit: T1 audited the four open NR gates at argument level, ran the settling computations, and wrote the memo. Headline: the corpus's self-declared replication gates are accurate in six of eight load-bearing steps, but miss two defect-candidates and one unflagged gap. (1) NR-A2b: the null-transport theorem (w1) is a GAP — 'stationary single-frequency' does not exclude helical streamlines, and |v|=c with axial flow gives r_perp <= lambda-bar, not =; the corpus's own NR-A1 graded the same step honestly as 'not yet a theorem'. The 3/4-Casimir step (w2) is a DEFECT-CANDIDATE: for any displacement operator dr = c*S (all Wigner-Eckart allows), Casimir/stretched-projection^2 = s(s+1)/s^2 = 3 at s=1/2, not 3/4; the printed 3/4 mixes 2S/hbar normalization on the projection face with S/hbar on the Casimir face, and the only reading that yields 3/4 ('extent'=peak-to-peak) contradicts Section 1's radius-lambda-bar ring. The s(s+1) vs (s+1)/2 degeneracy caveat itself is SOUND arithmetic. The w3 protection quartet is a GAP conditional on w1's exactness. (2) NR-D2: arithmetic spine recomputed independently — F-R1 confirmed (KE x25, conservative); two new minor slips found (lambda_dB printed ~1e2 fm is actually 3.3e3 fm at the stated v; sigma/m 5e18 corresponds to m~60f not the 16f used for KE in the same section) — both harmless to the verdict. The SDiff-reachability premise is a GAP, but direction-safe: F-R4's frozen-value lemma cuts BOTH ways — it undermines the screening mechanism's theorem-status (a reconciliation changes director values, and no compositional SDiff pullback changes a value distribution — the exact defect-class F-R4 proved against G.5), while STRENGTHENING the kill (no exactly-flat channel can reorient values, so the epsilon-lifted cost is a floor, closing escape gamma rigorously); every disposition of the gap lands on KILL, with margins 8-10+ orders. The web channel's cost coefficient is NOT-AUDITABLE-FROM-TEXT. (3) NR-D1b: arithmetic all verified (8pi/3=8.378, x1.496 clearance, S=201 vs 92); the floor is a GAP with the two corpus-flagged inputs (c_h,min, r_min — plus a checkable subtlety: one-constant elasticity makes radial and hyperbolic hedgehogs degenerate at 8pi, so the [8pi/3,8pi] band encodes unstated anisotropy) AND one unflagged gap: Section 1(iii) admits negative O(1)-fractional binding corrections while the theorem asserts all contributions positive; the eternal verdict needs binding < 33% of E1 at the epsilon-tail's bottom and no such bound is given. F-D1b-2's one-sided-bound logic is SOUND conditional on the floor. (4) NR-K2b: factorization is a GAP (Q-independence of the texture overlap asserted, not derived; the corpus's own gate names it correctly). NR-K3a: DEFECT-CANDIDATE — (i) the printed spectral formula m(k)=m_bar*delta3(k)+fluctuations at k~1/L is false for line-supported density (sparse tubes are broadband to k~1/a); (ii) the observable is quadratic in the amplitude: rate = <|A|^2>, and with kernel range ~2 fm << tube spacing ~micron, <|A|^2>/|<A>|^2 ~ 1/phi ~ 1e14 (a=1/f) to 2.5e16 (thin tubes) — the 'negligible' fluctuation term dominates by 14+ orders, in the OPPOSITE direction from the audit's branch-(b) collapse, so both original fork branches may be wrong and the four-cell collapse is unsupported. Printed uncertainty: this is an estimate-backed challenge (static web, linear insertion, uniform tube support assumed); motional narrowing or a smooth bulk component of m would rescue it — none is in the text. Seven numeric follow-ons specified, the decisive cheap one being a Monte-Carlo line network convolved with the 2-fm kernel for K3a, and an SDiff-projected two-texture relaxation for NR-D2's P4.
